data_provenance: Synthetic benign + card-testing windows (app/ml/anomaly.py). Benign set includes hard negatives: persistent honest retriers and B2B bulk payers. Unsupervised: attacks are never used for training, only for evaluation.

outage_detection.stream: 5 independent 30-day streams, ~25093 payments each, 10 injected outages per stream (60-240 min, 80-95% failures)
outage_detection.note: Scanned every 15 minutes with an exact binomial test (alpha=1e-4). Recall is limited by payment volume: quiet hours and low-volume methods (netbanking, wallet) cannot accumulate enough attempts for a statistically sound test, so the detector stays silent rather than guess.
